mentions.name: TCPViewer
mentions.description: A native macOS packet analyzer built as an alternative to Wireshark. Written in Cocoa (not SwiftUI) on top of libwireshark, it shows detailed packet views and supports protocols including TCP, UDP, DNS, and HTTP2.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I spent few months to buil the alternative to Wireshark. Native macOS app, built with Cocoa (Sorry SwiftUI), on top of libwireshark, so you can see the packet details like Wireshark. Support TCP, UDP, DNS, HTTP2, ...

https://tcpviewer.proxyman.com/
mentions.author: nghiatran_uit
